headline: Saudi Arabia Postpones Future Investment Initiative After Houthi Attacks
summary: Saudi Arabia has postponed its Future Investment Initiative conference following recent Houthi attacks in the region.
why: The Future Investment Initiative is a flagship economic event designed to attract foreign capital and diversify Saudi Arabia's oil-dependent economy.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Postponing a major international investment summit temporarily stalls foreign capital inflows and diversification initiatives.
